WITH unit_shares AS (
  SELECT
    sf.zoneref AS site_code,
    sf.articount AS artifact_count,
    sf.articount::numeric / NULLIF(SUM(sf.articount) OVER (), 0) AS share
  FROM scanfeatures AS sf
),
scored AS (
  SELECT
    site_code,
    artifact_count,
    share,
    share - AVG(share) OVER () AS difference_from_average
  FROM unit_shares
)
SELECT site_code, artifact_count, share, difference_from_average
FROM scored
WHERE share IS NOT NULL
  AND difference_from_average IS NOT NULL
ORDER BY difference_from_average DESC NULLS LAST
LIMIT 10;

assumptions.assumption: A zero overall artifact total makes shares undefined, so the query returns no rows, consistent with the instruction to return no rows when the overall total is missing.
